items.title: 5.6.1 Using Excel and Google Sheets for Visualization (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.6.1 (PDF 148-149, printed 145-146).

blocks.text: Excel aur Google Sheets: in tools mein aap aasani se data likh kar kai qism ke visualizations bana sakte hain, jaise bar charts, line graphs aur pie charts.

Misal: Farz karein aap ka apne ilaqe mein chhota business hai aur aap dekhna chahte hain ke har mahine kitne products bikte hain. Har mahine ka data Excel ya Google Sheets mein likhein, aur chand clicks mein bar chart ban jayega jo dikhayega ke kis mahine sab se zyada sales hui.

blocks.prompt: Data visualization ke liye MS Excel jaise tools istemal karne ka kya maqsad hai? (Short question 5)
blocks.explanation: Yeh kisi ko bhi table mein data rakh kar chand clicks mein, programming ke baghair, saaf chart banane dete hain, ta ke sab se zyada sales wala mahina jaise patterns jaldi nazar aayein aur share ho sakein; data badle to chart bhi badal jata hai.

items: Spreadsheets: data likhein, chand clicks mein chart banayein.
